pages.title: A Library on the Surface
pages.text: Travelers speak of a lone library standing above ground, its foundations hiding a stair down into darkness. Whoever built it left more than books behind.

Beneath the library winds a chain of chambers, tunnels, and treasure rooms. Those who explore deep enough are said to find chests holding Ancient Spell Books - and worse things guarding them. Bring a light, and bring friends.

pages.title: Something Sleeps Below
pages.text: Rarest of all is a pitfall leading to a vast, sunken chamber - and the thing that still dreams at the bottom of it. Waking it is not recommended for the unprepared.
